newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were slightly weaker in after-hours trade on Wednesday after prices drifted within tight ranges during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.5 yen per kg lower than the day's close. The benchmark May contract was 0.2 yen weaker at 142.0 yen. Volume was 4,134 lots.

The market started the day on a weaker tone, pressured by the firmer yen. "Thin trading conditions have continued amid a dearth of fresh factors. Unless strong support from overseas markets emerges, prices are unlikely to rise sharply," one trader said. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-7431
